setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step phrase on steps 1 to 4 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) through the test device on OUT 1, in C major at 90 BPM with sixteenth-note steps (rate /1). Each step is a single voice: no chord notes are set and Harmony is Off. Playback is stopped and the norns shows the Device page.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Open Masks for channel 1 and turn E3 one detent on Chd1, the first chord note. Chd1 reads 2nd: each step now sounds a second voice one scale step above its note, so the pairs are C+D, D+E, E+F and F+G (60+62, 62+64, 64+65, 65+67).
steps.title: Add a second voice

steps.caption: Open Channel tasks > Harmony; the header reads VOICE LEADING CH01.
steps.title: Open Harmony

steps.caption: Set Mode to REVOICE and press K3 (Preset SMOOTH). Tap Play for two loops. Revoice keeps each pair's two pitch classes but chooses their octaves for the smoothest movement: both notes drop an octave to 48+50, 50+52, 52+53 and 53+55, at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97 in the strip below. Tap Stop.
steps.title: Revoice the pairs
